rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that you find where something is.

example.english: I finally managed to locate the restaurant.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when you put or position something in a particular place.

example.english: Locate the router beside the window.
example.traditional: 你將個路由器放喺窗邊啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 go3 lou6 jau4 hei3 fong3 hai2 coeng1 bin1 laa1

rows.note: Use this when an authority or planner selects and settles on a site for something such as a hospital.

example.english: The government has decided where to locate the hospital.
example.traditional: 政府已經揀定醫院嘅位置喇。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ji5 ging1 gaan2 ding6 ji1 jyun2 ge3 wai6 zi3 laa3
